notes: Promotes beta v27.6.17. Place matching is substring based and search_text carried the day name, so a query token that is a substring of a French day name matched. Searching Notre-Dame-de-la-Mer, a real church at Albion, returned 20 rows across 16 different churches - every Notre-Dame on the island - because mer is inside mercredi, and only their Wednesday Masses came back. day_of_week is now excluded from search_text; the day is filtered structurally and parsed out of the query separately, so it was never needed there. That search now returns 5 rows at the one church, prefix search still works, and 18 further search cases pass with zero violations. No Mass time changed: 426 rows, 121 sites.
